lane: backend_proxy_lane: credits schema read alignment and unsafe debit gate
goal: Apply a shared verified-account and bounded JSON-body guard to Tarot and Persona POST before parsing/config/provider/write, with sanitized failures and local fake-auth/stream tests; do not activate quota/spend or deploy.
successCriteria: Missing/malformed/oversize Bearer, failed/anonymous/unknown auth class or invalid verified UUID does not read body or reach configuration/provider/persistence.
Only JSON object requests <=32768 UTF8 bytes accepted, including when Content-Length is absent/false; malformed/multibyte/stream failure/5s timeout have stable sanitized errors.
Current successful Tarot/Persona payloads and response shapes remain; pure local Deno tests and both entry type checks pass without provider/network/live writes.
Quota, total provider token budget, atomic reservation and other AI endpoints are explicitly still pending; no local guard is reported as full R10/G1 acceptance.
untouchedSurfaces: No live writes, project retarget, migration SQL, deploy, publish or release.
App/account bridge and privacy integration require separate root record; historical planning backlog untouched.

impact.entryPoint: Existing ai-tarot-reading and ai-persona-chat POST; OPTIONS and method gate preserved.
impact.dataWrite: Exact local source/test/doc only. Verified user id continues to own existing successful persistence; rejected request reaches no provider or write.
impact.backendContract: Shared body cap 32768 bytes and 5 second body-read deadline; verified getUser UUID and explicit non-anonymous; no client token decode used as identity.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin config/publish/Test Run changes. These two production source entrypoints share guard; not deployed.
impact.privacySafety: Never return raw auth/JSON/stream error or log body/token; bounded incoming body, no private fixture or secret reads.
impact.observability: Error codes/statuses only; no new raw payload trace.
impact.rollback: Revert only this slice if necessary, keep deployments off until reviewed cost/QA gates; do not revive unsafe debit.

canonicalContracts: Existing Tarot prepareTarotContext and Persona assembler/request fields preserved; no new quota value or provider route policy activated.
Authenticated users for configured AI flows; explicit anonymous/unknown class fail closed as in R10 credits; local mobile fallback remains separate.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Fresh exact QA plan with full results and separate browser/native/CI/live gates; no skipped case or inflated timeout.

dependencyReview.evidence: Current repository SQL and sanitized read-only Supabase catalogs; official migration/RLS docs reviewed in R02, no install or guessed compatibility fix.

securityReview.authzRls: getUser(token) verifies identity; UUID and is_anonymous false required. Client uses caller JWT/anon/RLS and no service key.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Synthetic stream/body/auth fixtures only; no real users or raw database rows.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No env values printed; error codes only and no new body/token logging.
securityReview.externalInput: Untrusted headers/body bounded before JSON parse and downstream; declared length cannot bypass counted UTF8 bytes; stalled body times out.
securityReview.dependencies: Use existing cached SDK/Web Streams, no install/import version update.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No SQL/deploy/provider call/retarget. Other AI endpoints and absence of quota/atomic guard remain release blockers, not expanded by scoped validation.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop unexpected changes or remote/spend action; report unverified native/live and enforce no fake pass.

workingTreeReview.note: Preserve existing R13 Tarot prompt work, Persona method/history/persistence and extensive unrelated dirty tree. No App, route, SQL, dependency or live edits.

validationCommands: Existing Tarot prompt tests and npm run validate:backend
managerTestPath: Read local fixture results: rejected requests do not call fake continuation/body; normal synthetic payload passes with verified account and fields preserved. Live trial follows QA/cost approvals separately.
residualRisk: 32KiB incoming cap is not a tokenizer/system/retrieval cost cap. Other AI endpoints, provider input history/sections/parser, quotas/reservation/RLS and native acceptance remain open.
